label: H.R. 1526
title: NORRA of 2025

latest_action.text: Received in the Senate and Read twice and referred to the Committee on the Judiciary.

summary: No Rogue Rulings Act or NORRA This bill limits the authority of federal district courts to issue injunctions. Specifically, it prohibits a district court from issuing an injunction unless the injunction applies only to the parties of the particular case before the court.
summary_short: No Rogue Rulings Act or NORRA This bill limits the authority of federal district courts to issue injunctions.
